name: mobysuite-reports
description: Sales reporting for managers using Mobysuite.

interface.longDescription: Free sales reporting for managers and administrators using Mobysuite in Chile. Connect through OAuth and enter your real estate company identifier in the Mobysuite authorization form. The MCP integration does not store queries or report results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me review the sales reports available in my Mobysuite account.

publication.release_notes: Use a shared MCP endpoint and choose the customer in the Mobysuite OAuth form.

es-CL.subtitle: Reportes de ventas gerenciales
es-CL.description: Complemento gratuito para consultar reportes de ventas de Mobysuite en Chile, destinado a gerentes y administradores. Conecta mediante OAuth e indica tu inmobiliaria en el campo Customer del formulario de Mobysuite. La integración MCP solo consulta datos y no guarda las consultas ni los resultados.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free and does not offer purchases or payment processing.
prompts: Ayúdame a revisar los reportes de ventas disponibles en mi cuenta de Mobysuite.
